## Organic promotion — reference to original product video | Source method
Source: https://www.instagram.com/adley/reel/DagnDGKhiNl/
Evidence: 00:00–00:44 (one coarse source segment).

Source sequence preserved, applied to your product. Hidden prompts and APIs remain unavailable; browser production is an explicit handoff.

1. Open Start; its test form works before activation.
2. Product links/facts live in Product details JSON. Start with Brief only.
3. SETUP controls count and upload size.
4. Production pauses at Studio handoff. Use your existing browser account and upload the actual MP4.
5. Download the ZIP with videos, captions, prompts and evidence.

No API keys embedded, no account creation, no fabricated provider API. Provider generation is a browser handoff. Native n8n form waits resume the run. No auto-publishing or paid ads.

Source's hidden prompt is unavailable; the timed production brief is an explicit reconstruction.

sourceSteps: Find 10 relevant pages in your niche.
Use Sort Feed to identify reference videos, targeting more than 10 million views.
Put selected references into a spreadsheet.
Record original videos with a tripod; the speaker proposes 10 per day.
Connect content to a suitable offer.
Consider retargeting after building an audience; paid launch is a separate account/budget step.
commerce.sourceHandoff: Use the supplied reference table as your spreadsheet. Film original footage using the reference structures, your real product and the provided timed brief. Do not copy the source video. Edit the result with your preferred editor and return the MP4 here. Paid retargeting is an explicit downstream handoff, with no ad spend executed by this workflow.
